# ADR-NNNN: Title (imperative, decisive)

- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-NNNN | Deprecated
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Decision drivers:** the 2–4 forces that actually decided this

## Context

What is true about the world and this kit that forces a decision. Facts,
constraints, and prior decisions only — no solutioning here. Include dated,
versioned facts about external dependencies when they matter (they go stale;
date them so future-you knows when to re-verify).

## Decision

What we will do, stated in full sentences in the present tense. Strong
opinions, precisely scoped. Include the boundaries of the decision — what it
deliberately does NOT cover.

## Alternatives considered

Each alternative gets: what it is, why it's attractive, and the specific
reason it lost. Honest entries only — an alternatives section that exists to
flatter the decision is worthless.

## Consequences

- What becomes easier
- What becomes harder, and what we'll do about it
- New risks accepted, with the tripwire that would cause us to revisit
  (each risk names its revisit trigger)

## Revisit when

Concrete, observable triggers ("Wails v3 ships stable mobile", "the dataset
exceeds N", "CUE gengotypes graduates"), not dates alone.
